AMENDED REPORT: This report replaces Viapath Genetics report dated 06/10/2017 which contains an incorrect family name in the reason for referral. We apologise for this mistake.

REASON FOR REFERRALU: Test for familial FGFR3 variant
This individual is the daughter of person in whom the pathogenic FGFR3 sequence variant c.1620C>A (p.Asn540Lys) has been identified (see GSTS report dated 23/05/2012).
TEST

Test for the familial variant in the Fibroblast Growth Factor Receptor 3 gene (FGFR3) by bidirectional fluorescent Sanger DNA sequencing.

RESULTS 

No pathogenic variant detected
SUMMARY 

This individual has NOT inherited the familial pathogenic variant.

A significant level of maternal cell contamination of the umbilical cord blood sample has been excluded*.
FURTHER WORK
We recommend that this individual is referred to their local Clinical Genetics department to discuss the implications of this result.

Notes

* The presence of maternal cell contamination at a level of less than approximately 10% may not be detected.
Exon 13 including intron/exon boundaries of the FGFR3 gene were screened by fluorescent sequence analysis on genomic DNA.  

Variant nomenclature based on FGFR3 reference sequence NM_000142.4, with nucleotide number 1 corresponding to the first base of the translation initiation codon.
